cues.en: Usually the CPU is done a bit quicker, which means that the RCP has a monopoly on the RAM access, which makes the RCP run a bit faster.

cues.en: Since they often run in parallel with this architecture, you often have the issue that the renderer and the CPU share the same RAM bus.
cues.zh: 在这种架构下，它们通常是并行运行的，所以经常会遇到渲染器和 CPU 共享同一条内存总线的问题。

cues.en: This leads to them permanently fighting over the same resources while they are running in parallel.
cues.zh: 这导致它们在并行运行时，会一直争抢相同的资源。

cues.en: Having the CPU finished before the RCP means that the RCP can use the RAM bus all for itself
cues.zh: 让 CPU 比 RCP 先完成，意味着 RCP 可以独占内存总线，

cues.en: and it can render new frames quicker than it would if the CPU was still running.

cues.en: This means that the faster the CPU is done, the less they will have this infighting and the faster we can render a frame.
cues.zh: 也就是说，CPU 处理得越快，它们之间的资源争抢就越少，我们渲染一帧的速度也就越快。
